Adzuna is a job board CareJobs.Now also reads: a source of other employers' jobs, each listing naming its employer.
Job search engine that gathers healthcare jobs from employer sites, agencies and job boards across the US.
Adzuna is a job search engine that gathers job ads from employer career sites, staffing agencies and job boards. This board reads its newest US healthcare and nursing listings every day, keeps the jobs in care, and leaves out the employers it already reads directly.
Headquarters: London, UK.
31,995 listings right now, by kind of job: Nurses 13,252; Therapy & rehab 5,436; Doctors 2,739; Imaging 2,414; Mental health 1,712; NPs & PAs 1,181; Caregivers 894; Lab 778; Dental 777; CNAs & PCTs 773; Pharmacy 541; Allied health 463; Front desk & admin 435; Medical assistants 286; Surgical 219; EMS 95.
Adzuna, posted pay on its open jobs: typical $25 to $70/hr, median $40/hr (from 2,972 distinct posted hourly rates; 28,199 of the 31,995 open jobs post no hourly rate).
